item.tib: dbal phur nag po'i phrin las 'bring po gsang gzer dang bsdus pa srog len gnyis kyi mngon rtogs ye shes rgyan
item.coloph: zhes pa dbal phur 'bring po gsang gzer dang bsdus pa srog len gnyis kyi mngon rtogs ye shes rgyan zhes bya ba phur pa'i rnal 'byor shar rdza ba bkra shis rgyal mtshan 'jig med dbang po la bon sgo 'di la mos pa'i dge sbyong ba dbang phyug dang sangs rgyas ming can gnyis kyis yang yang bskul nas g.yung drung lhun po'i dben khrod du sbyar ba dge'o//
